subject: math
description: Apply coordinate geometry, triangle validity, midpoint, distance, and solid volume skills to design a coordinate-based structure with triangular supports and solid components.
learningObjectives: Design a coordinate-based structure using ordered pairs on a site plan
Compute horizontal, vertical, and diagonal distances between points
Find the midpoint of a segment and explain what it represents in a design
Check whether three given side lengths can form a valid triangle
Compute volumes of rectangular prisms, cylinders, and triangular prisms in a combined structure
Justify design decisions using coordinate and measurement evidence
prerequisites: Plot and read ordered pairs on the coordinate plane
Use the distance formula for coordinate pairs
Find the midpoint of two coordinate points
Use volume formulas for common solids
